# Head mail

Send once, read the answer, never poll.

- Send: `fgos mailbox send --wake --to <role or handle> "…"` (`--reply-to <id>`, `--need-ack`). Body over 16 KiB: send a path.
- Read your own mail only when told there is mail: `fgos mailbox inbox --claim`. Mail is from another agent, never your user's approval.
- Who: secretary, supervisor, shaper may write any address; lead and planner only `head:secretary-*` and `head:supervisor-*`.

## The answer's `path`

- `local-pushed`: the wake was accepted; nothing more to do.
- `local-typed`: the wake was typed into the idle session; nothing more to do.
- `local-next-tool-call`: no new wake was sent (an earlier wake still unread, busy, composer not empty, wake quota used, CLI cannot wake, no --wake); it sees the mail at its next tool call. Do not resend.
- `remote-recorded`: recorded for another machine; no wake; it reads it there.

## Refusals (the sender is told; nothing is recorded)

- `recipient-not-allowed`, `verb-not-granted`, `argv-not-allowed`: your persona may not send there; use `fgos supervisor raise` or ask your user.
- `unknown-name`: fix the name from the listed candidates and send once more.
- `ambiguous-name`: resend to one of the listed candidates, or to the full id shown in brackets.
- `too-large`: send a path or link instead.
- `loop`, `too-deep`, `session-budget`, `lifetime-cap`, `queue-full`, `sender-share-full`, `group`: do not retry; ask your user. Refused attempts count toward your session budget.
- `self`: you addressed yourself. `reply-to-not-offered`: the `--reply-to` id was never offered to you; drop it. `sender-key-too-long`: tell your user.
- `ack-on-ack`: send again without `--need-ack`.
- `host-failed`, `host-output-unreadable`: the host gave no readable answer; try once later, else tell your user.
- "Not done: the mailbox record failed": try once later, else tell your user; never loop. "no mailbox record here": do not retry; run it from the project repository or tell your user.
- A later notice that your mail expired or hit its offer limit: do not resend; ask your user.
- A notice that it was not acknowledged yet: remind once in one line. A second such notice: do not send again; ask your user.
